evidence_basis: RPMS arXiv:2603.17831v1: frozen shared memory plus retrieval-time State-Consistent Filtering, with isolated SCF-off cost of -3.7 pp Memory-only and -6.0 pp Full RPMS on ALFWorld
semantic_controls: compatible candidate may be injected when state/snapshot/policy/candidate-set bindings are fresh
all-incompatible candidate set with empty injection is valid
interpretation: This is additive to memory_admission_runtime_v1. Admission/retrieval is not treated as durable authority to inject a memory. Immediately before each decision-step injection, the current state signature, state revision, memory snapshot, candidate set, compatibility policy and packet digest must still match the compatibility check. Empty injection remains a valid outcome.
scope_limit: 12/12 validates protocol semantics only. RPMS supplies exact isolated quantitative SCF evidence on ALFWorld and transfer of the mechanism to ScienceWorld, but the paper does not report a numerical ScienceWorld SCF-off delta and no official public implementation revision was located in the current search.
